item.title: Today we’re releasing Reflect Open, a complete rewrite of Reflect for the age of AI. It’s local-first and
item.author: @reflectnotes
item.description:
Today we’re releasing Reflect Open, a complete rewrite of Reflect for the age of AI.

It’s local-first and open source, and every note is stored as a Markdown file on your computer.

item.title: The shape of Reflect is still there: daily notes, backlinks, tasks, search and chat with your notes. The
item.author: @reflectnotes
item.description:
The shape of Reflect is still there: daily notes, backlinks, tasks, search and chat with your notes.

The important difference is underneath. Your data lives in ordinary files, the app works offline, and the code is open for anyone to inspect or change.

item.author: @reflectnotes
item.description:
Google Cloud has a big outage right now. Reflect relies on Google Cloud extensively, especially Firebase, and as such we are also down.

You can track the status of this issue on the Google Cloud status page. We do apologize about this!

https://status.cloud.google.com

item.title: In-line transcriptions work on our macOS and browser apps. Using the original voice transcriber microphone next to the
item.author: @reflectnotes
item.description:
In-line transcriptions work on our macOS and browser apps.

Using the original voice transcriber microphone next to the search box (or the + button on the mobile apps) will still have the voice note land in your daily note.

item.title: We’ve added an in-line voice transcriber to Reflect. It lets you transcribe text in real-time, anywhere in your
item.author: @reflectnotes
item.description:
We’ve added an in-line voice transcriber to Reflect. It lets you transcribe text in real-time, anywhere in your notes.

Hit the Option key twice (or press Option + Space) to toggle the transcriber on and off. On Windows, use Alt instead of Option.

item.author: @reflectnotes
item.description:
We just released OCR text for images and PDFs saved in Reflect!

That means Reflect’s search can now index the text inside any new files you add. You’ll also need to have “Labs” turned on in your preferences.
